name: The Usurper's Claim
about: A great lord finds a claim to the throne that's better than yours, secretly wins another house to it, and marches on Kingsmere. Each step comes to your court. Gold buys time, but it doesn't end it.
title: The Claim of {pretender.house}
fade: {thread} is talked about less every season, and then not at all.

beats.speaker: witness
text: In {seat}, {pretender} has found letters in the old archive saying the Conqueror's line ran through {pretender.house}, not yours. The rumours reach Kingsmere before the snow.
People in {seat} say a boy there is the last son of the old kings, raised in secret, and {pretender} keeps him close. The rumours reach Kingsmere before the snow.
{pretender} tells any lord who'll listen that the crown went to the wrong brother three generations ago, and {pretender.he} means to put it right.

court.text: {witness} of {witness.house}: "Your Grace, {pretender} is talking about a better claim to your throne, and some lords are listening. What should I tell them?"

options.label: Summon {pretender} to Kingsmere to answer for it
options.result: {pretender} is summoned to Kingsmere. {pretender.He} comes, bows low, and says nothing about claims. The rumours stop for now.

options.label: Buy {pretender}'s silence (200 gold)
options.hint: {pretender.houseName} +10 · it buys time but doesn't end it
options.result: Gold goes north to {seat}. For a season, {pretender} talks only about the harvest.

options.label: Let them talk, and watch who listens
options.result: The King lets the rumour spread. In every hall, someone is counting who agrees.

beats.speaker: pretender
beats.text: {seat} is quiet, and its lord spends the King's gold on new walls and more men.

beats.speaker: pretender
text: A rider carrying {pretender.house}'s seal is caught on the road to {backer.seat}. His letter promises {backer.house} a duchy when {pretender} is crowned.
{pretender} and {backer} meet at a hunting lodge between their lands. By morning they've sworn to back the old claim together.

court.text: {witness} lays a broken seal before the throne: "{pretender} and {backer} have sworn to each other, Your Grace. Strike now, or win one of them back."

options.label: Seize {pretender}'s envoys and read the letters to the court
options.result: The letters are read aloud in the great hall. {backer} goes white. {pretender} goes home and sharpens swords.

options.label: Win {backer} back to the crown (300 gold)
options.result: {backer} takes the King's gold and the King's hand, and sends {pretender}'s letters back unopened.

options.label: Let them plot, because letters don't win thrones
options.result: The King lets them plot. In {seat} the smiths work all night.

beats.speaker: pretender
beats.text: Left alone, and still friendly to the crown, {pretender} burns the old letters in the hall at {seat}. Nobody speaks of the claim again.

memory.pretender: I had a claim to the throne, and I let it go.

beats.speaker: pretender
beats.text: {pretender} claims the throne in the square at {seat}. The banners of {pretender.house} go up, and every house has to pick a side.

court.text: {witness}: "It's open war, Your Grace. {pretender} has claimed the throne. How does the crown answer?"

options.label: Declare {pretender} a traitor and an outlaw
options.hint: {pretender.houseName} −40 · the realm has to pick a side · call the banners after
options.result: Heralds ride to every town: {pretender} is an outlaw, and anyone who shelters {pretender.him} is a traitor too.

options.label: Offer {pretender} a seat on the council (500 gold)
options.hint: {pretender.houseName} +25 · a chance at peace, but it looks weak
options.result: The King offers {pretender} a seat at his right hand. The whole realm waits to see if {pretender.he} takes it.

beats.speaker: pretender
beats.text: {pretender} rides to Kingsmere under a white banner and kneels. {pretender} drops the claim, but keeps the council seat.

memory.pretender: I knelt to the King, and he gave me a seat at his side.

beats.speaker: pretender
beats.text: {pretender}'s army marches on Kingsmere. If the walls fall, the crown falls with them.

beats.speaker: witness
beats.text: {pretender}'s army is broken outside Kingsmere. The claim dies in the mud, and the houses that stood by the crown won't forget it.

memory.pretender: My claim was broken before the walls of Kingsmere.

beats.text: With {pretender} dead, nobody is left to carry the claim. {thread} is buried with {pretender.him}.
